title: Redis: live cluster status
description: Runs `nexus status redis` against the running Redis Cluster. Shows the 6 nodes' roles + statuses + shard map.

observe.what: 6-row table: 3 nodes role=primary + 3 nodes role=replica; status=alive for all; ShardId populated for primaries (slot range)
JSON ClusterStatusOutputJson with 6 ClusterMemberJson entries + overallHealth=green

whatProves: The RedisAdapter's GetStatusAsync correctly parses `CLUSTER NODES` output and renders + serializes the topology cleanly.
